title: Hawk-Sight Canon of the Far Shot
summary: Trains a Xiantian gunner to hold a far mark with a thread of qi and drop a ball on it like a hawk.

title: Paired Battery Treatise of Crossed Fire
summary: Teaches two guns of a Xiantian battery to cross their fire on one point and cage the lane between them.

title: River Enfilade Canon
summary: Teaches a Xiantian gun captain to rake a column along its length from a river bank and ford.

title: Azure Burst Treatise on the Fused Shell
summary: Teaches a Xiantian to time fused shells in pairs and chains and burst one great shell high overhead.

title: Dual-Track Canon of the Ranging Pair
summary: Binds a spotter and a gunner into one ranging pair so the ball lands where the spotter called.

title: Basin Echo Treatise on Counter-Fire
summary: Trains a Xiantian crew to locate an enemy gun by echo and flash and silence it with a single reply.
